visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female shopkeeper wearing a yellow T-shirt and a green apron with a duck logo is chopping braised pork on a round wooden cutting board using a large cleaver. The scene is brightly lit, showing the textures of the meat and the wooden surface clearly. (2) The camera moves to a display case filled with a wide variety of cold braised items like duck gizzards, pig tails, and meats. The shopkeeper uses a metal bowl to select and gather portions of these items. (3) A series of close-up shots follow, showcasing individual food items held by chopsticks against the background of the stall. These include glossy pig tail cross-sections, tender pork tendons, dark rice blood cakes, and fresh green broccoli. (4) The shopkeeper is then shown at a hot station, blanching leafy green vegetables and noodles in a boiling pot. She vigorously tosses the cooked noodles in a metal bowl with savory brown sauce. (5) The focus shifts to honey-braised duck wings with a deep orange-red glaze. The shopkeeper chops them into smaller pieces on the board. (6) The video concludes with a handheld shot of the shop's storefront, featuring a pink and yellow sign with the text '888 燻茶鵝·滷味' and the shop's address, while a passer-by is seen in the background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female shopkeeper as the main character, 1 female passer-by seen briefly at the end.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is a woman with her hair tied back with a beige bow headband. She is wearing a yellow T-shirt, a green professional apron with a white duck logo, and a black face mask.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A traditional Taiwanese street-side food stall with a large refrigerated display case for braised items and a cooking station for boiling noodles. The background shows signs with menu items and a typical urban street view.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a series of distinct, sharp percussive 'clacks' from a knife on a wooden board. A female voice speaks casually, noting that some ingredients are rare. Upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and light piano BGM provides a rhythmic bed at 110 BPM. (2) A transition occurs as a professional female narrator takes over with a higher arousal level and enthusiastic tone, explaining the shop's 30-year history. The chopping SFX continues sporadically. (3) As the visuals show sauce being added, a 'splashing' liquid sound and the 'clinking' of metal spoons against bowls are heard. The narrator maintains a steady, energetic pace, listing specific ingredients. (4) The sound of bubbling water and the mechanical shaking of a metal noodle strainer become prominent during the hot cooking phase. The narrator's pitch rises slightly to emphasize the recommendation of noodles. (5) The rhythmic chopping sounds return while the narrator discusses the duck wings. The BGM remains constant until the end, where the narrator provides the address and a cheerful sign-off, followed by a quick fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Historical Context -> Cold Food Showcase -> Hot Food Showcase -> Signature Item -> CTA/Address
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review of a traditional Taiwanese braised food stall. It aims to attract customers by highlighting the wide selection of items, the unique flavors of both cold and hot preparations, and the shop's long-standing reputation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the brand, shows the storefront, provides the address, and uses promotional language to recommend the food.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality social media production with fast cuts and dense subtitles tailored for mobile food discovery.
